text:
Noah (PM): Noticed a confusing race in the routing policies editor: drag-to-reorder + immediate "Run simulator" sometimes shows the old order. Repro: create 4 rules, move #4 to top, click run. Happens intermittently.

Priya (Eng-UX): Can reproduce on Chrome/Firefox. Root cause looks like we snapshot DOM order before our state commit applies. setState batching likely.

Samira (Design): Users in testing thought the drag failed because left list updated but simulator lagged. Need to avoid that mental mismatch.

Lena (A11y): Keyboard reorders also glitch: after move the focused item report is stale for screen readers. We'll need announcements like "Moved to position 1 of 4".

Priya (Eng-UX): Proposed fix: 1) have simulator read canonical order from Context/store after commit; 2) add a short simulator loading state (shimmer) and aria-live message while applying; 3) debounce capture as a fallback (50ms).

Noah (PM): Agreed. Also product wants clearer validation copy when two rules overlap. Current "Conflict" is too vague. Show which rules and which fields overlap with suggested action.

Samira (Design): Suggested primary copy: "Rule conflict: 'geo=EU' overlaps with 'country=DE' in rule 'EU traffic' 14 consider adding a more specific condition or lowering priority." Short fallback: "Overlapping conditions between Rule A and Rule B."

Lena (A11y): When showing conflict, focus the error summary and provide a keyboard-focusable "Go to rule" action that moves focus to the offending card. Use aria-describedby on the card.

Priya (Eng-UX): Technical note: backend returns conflict metadata (ids, fields). We'll map ids->display names and render the suggested copy. Also will add unit tests for reorder+capture.

Noah (PM): One more UX nit: users expect index badges to reflect tentative positions during drag. Current behavior shows saved numbers until you hit save. Can we show a muted "saved" index and an accent "will be" index while dragging, plus an "Apply order" CTA?

Samira (Design): Yes. Two-state badge: grey saved number, blue tentative number with tooltip "Will become #2 on save". For hosted users we can default to auto-commit on drop; enterprise stays manual behind flag.

Lena (A11y): If auto-commit is enabled, announce "Order saved" and expose an undo action reachable by keyboard. Ensure undo restores focus predictably.

CI-Bot: CI queued for branch fix/sim-order-capture 14 tests running.

Priya (Eng-UX): I'll open a PR implementing store-based capture, shimmer + aria-live text, transient badges, and keyboard-focus fixes. Will include RTL/Jest tests and an a11y e2e.

Noah (PM): Thanks. Please include copy variants from Samira in the PR description and assign for review. Drop any additional edgecases (filters + canary fallbacks) here.

Samira (Design): Also uploading color token adjustments; simulator highlight contrast fails on dark theme.

Lena (A11y): I'll run contrast checks on the new tokens and add acceptance criteria.

Priya (Eng-UX): Draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/routing-editor/pull/489 (WIP).
